title: Argon2id password hashing in PHC form
spec: Implement crates/accounts/src/password.rs as its doc comments say, with the argon2 crate (already a dependency): Argon2id, version 0x13, Params::new(MEMORY_KIB, ITERATIONS, LANES, Some(32)), PHC string output. check_policy counts chars() for the minimum and len() bytes for the maximum. hash_with_salt checks the policy, then encodes the salt with password_hash::SaltString::encode_b64 (Error::Hashing if refused). hash draws the salt with rand_core::OsRng. verify parses with PasswordHash::new and returns Err(BadHash) unless the algorithm is argon2id; verification uses the parameters stored in the hash. needs_rehash is true when the hash does not parse, is not argon2id, or m, t or p is below the constants. No new dependencies.
